name: dft
purpose: The spectrum of a formula in time: the strength of each whole frequency, from n ticks over one span. A sine of amplitude a gives a bar of a.
returns: a list of {id, value} for bars; the id is the frequency, and the span is 1 unit of time when it is [0, 1]

over.doc: {"t": [lo, hi, n]}: the name for time, its span and the number of ticks (default 64)

upto.doc: the highest frequency bin to give; the default is n / 2
